question: Which bodily centers are enumerated as locations for the cakras in this teaching?
premises: The secret place, navel, and heart are named.
The throat, mouth, and head are named.
The end of the tuft is also named.
inference: The teaching enumerates the secret place, navel, heart, throat, mouth, head, and tuft-end as centers.
plain_english: In the secret place, navel, heart, throat, mouth, head, and at the end of the tuft.
